function.name: triage_issue
function.description: Classify the problem with Summit Air's rules and get the next step. Returns urgency, reasons, next_action (safety_instructions, priority_dispatch, book_earliest, book_standard, explain_and_close, create_callback) and, when bookable, up to 3 offered_slots with spoken labels. For gas/CO/smoke, give safety instructions BEFORE calling this.

issue_type.description: Main problem. leak = active water or refrigerant leak.

co_alarm.description: A carbon monoxide alarm is going off.

vulnerable_occupants.description: Vulnerable people in the home. Empty array if none.

indoor_temp_f.description: Indoor temperature in Fahrenheit, only if the caller knows it.

property_type.description: residential for a house or apartment; commercial for a business.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

preferred_window.description: Caller's preferred time of day, if mentioned.

messages.content: Let me check that for you.
